decision: Do not map every ambient producer lifetime to one reusable registered game object.

evidence.behavior: Bound object dispatch posts using the existing ID; unbound dispatch delegates allocation for each nonempty launch.
Allocates before position/post. Failed post retires scratch and signals linked end; successful aged post seeks.
Persistent producer registration returns logical handle before physical launch; process_pending performs create/update/release in order.

removed_experiment.reason: Passing reuse tests only established the proposed implementation, not ambient native ownership. Experimental module and export removed before runtime integration.

next: Compose the qualified shared factory, scratch lifetime, registered objects, logical worker and actual PCM voice backend. Preserve distinct producer tokens, logical IDs, backend references, game-object IDs and playing IDs.
limits: Startup direction and RNG ownership remain explicit unresolved inputs.

qualified_startup.scope: Shared engine initialization; do not reset object ID for each producer. Backend reference0 is valid. Image vector is not the current listener basis.
